mgmt_bio.text: Shantanu Narayen, born May 27, 1963 in Hyderabad, India, holds a B.E. in electronics and communication engineering from Osmania University, an M.S. in computer science from Bowling Green State University and an MBA from UC Berkeley. Before Adobe he held product development roles at Apple and Silicon Graphics and co-founded the photo-sharing start-up Pictra. He joined Adobe in 1998 as vice president and general manager of its engineering technology group, became president and COO in 2005, CEO in 2007 and chairman of the board in 2017, overseeing Adobe's move from packaged software to a cloud-based subscription model. In March 2026 Adobe said he would transition out of the CEO role after a successor was appointed, and the board named Anil Chakravarthy president and CEO effective December 1, 2026, with Narayen moving to executive chair. He is also lead independent director of Pfizer Inc.
